lowmem_path.rule: bias_correct is replaced in the job's own process by lowmem.bias_correct: FP32 per-channel float64 sums per calibration chunk (32 images) once per job, then per arm only the quantized side, chunk by chunk with host-memory storage; every GPU kernel sees the same tensors as in tools/experiment_b2/engine.py bias_correct, so the result is meant to be bit-identical. No existing source file is edited; runner.OWN files are unchanged, so arm identities are unchanged and either path skips records the other wrote.

reproduction_gate_lowmem.applies_to: every (model, format) before its arms run through the low-memory path, unless the v1 verify job already passed
checks: digest of the sealed configuration file artifacts/experiment_b2/configurations/<id>.json equals the cell's configuration identity
activation scales of the shared state equal the sealed configuration's
weight scales equal the sealed configuration's
the bias-correction report of the ref_default arm through the low-memory path equals the sealed configuration's (digest)
readout arrays of that arm equal the sealed cell's
logits sha256 of that arm equals the sealed cell's
reproduction_gate_lowmem.note: runner.build (the heavy path) is not rerun; the sealed configuration stores what it computed. The per-job fingerprint check of v1 stays.
reproduction_gate_lowmem.first_gate: mobilenet_v3_large int8 (v1 verify already passed there; the gate tests the low-memory path itself)
reproduction_gate_lowmem.failure: any failing check stops the low-memory path for that (model, format); a failure on mobilenet_v3_large int8 stops it everywhere
